sink.description: HTTP GET /accelerator_requests/{arq_uuid}: arq_uuid concatenated into URL path via "/".join([self.ARQ_URL, arq_uuid]) without UUID-format or path-character validation

stoppedAt.detail: get_arq_by_uuid (defined at cyborg.py:337) does not appear anywhere in the 532-file source set — grep over src/ confirms it is only the definition. Five files call into cyborg.py (compute/api.py, compute/manager.py, compute/utils.py, conductor/manager.py, network/neutron.py) but all call get_client, get_device_profile_request_groups, get_arq_pci_device_profile, or get_device_amount_of_dp_groups. New namespaces added across all passes (nova.hacking, nova.image, nova.keymgr, nova.limit, nova.notifications, nova.pci, nova.policies, nova.privsep) contain no callers. The method's callers remain in source files not yet extracted from the nova codebase.

sanitisationGaps: No UUID format check or path-character filtering visible between method parameter (line 337) and HTTP call (lines 358-359) in get_arq_by_uuid.
